title: heptapleurum tomentosum var. farinosum
intro: Heptapleurum tomentosum var. farinosum, commonly known as Farina Plant, is a plant species belonging to the family Araliaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
